newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Savings to form holding company.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Savings to form holding company.

text.p: Northwest Savings Bank said on Wednesday that its board of directors has approved a plan that would reorganize the bank into a two-tier holding company structure.
Northwest Savings said shareholders will exchange their shares of stock in the bank for stock in the new holding company, which would be the parent company of the bank.

With the holding company structure, Northwest would be able to retain the benefits of a mutual holding company structure while giving the company some of the benefits available to stock holding companies.
The stock holding company structure has advantages for mergers and acquisitions, diversifying operations or buying back stock, Northwest Savings said.

The bank's existing mutual holding company, Northwest Bancorp MHC, will own a 70 percent interest in the common stock of the new stock holding company, unchanged from the percentage of stock it held in the bank.
Completion of the reorganization is subject to regulatory and stockholder approval, the company said.
